<header class="page-heading"><p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p><h1>Sentencing Memorandum</h1><p>Use this structure to organize a party’s requested sentence and the case-specific considerations offered in support.</p></header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> This outline does not supply a sentencing rule, guideline calculation, or legal conclusion. Use the authorities and record applicable to the actual case.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>UNITED STATES OF AMERICA v. [DEFENDANT]</h2><p>Case No. [CR-________]</p></div>
    <h2>[PARTY]’S SENTENCING MEMORANDUM</h2>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Convicted count(s)</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Identify verified count(s) and offense(s)]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Requested sentence</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[State requested sentence or components]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Procedural history</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Summarize the conviction-producing disposition and sentencing posture.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Sentencing considerations</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Address applicable factors, aggravating or mitigating information, and relevant record material.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Requested disposition</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[State the precise sentence requested.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Office / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
